Future graduate students
The David R. Cheriton School of Computer Science is one of the world's top-ranked institutions for computer science. With an international reputation in pure and applied research, we attract exceptional students from all over the world to study and conduct research with our award-winning faculty.
Why Computer Science at Waterloo?
There are many reasons to study computer science at Waterloo:
Learn from internationally acclaimed researchers
Access to research-intensive lab spaces
Publish your work in top journals and to present at premier conferences
The Waterloo Advantage
Unique to the University of Waterloo, however, is the the Waterloo Advantage: the ability to own your own work. At Waterloo, 100% of your ideas are yours to keep. Here you can refine your entrepreneurial aspirations and discover the tools available to ensure your success. Explore the University of Waterloo's IP policies.
Gain Work Experience
At Waterloo, MMath co-op students alternate study terms with work terms and graduate with up to two terms of relevant, paid work experience. This hands-on journey helps you navigate the job market and apply your research to real-world challenges.

The University of Waterloo acknowledges that much of our work takes place on the traditional territory of the Neutral, Anishinaabeg, and Haudenosaunee peoples. Our main campus is situated on the Haldimand Tract, the land granted to the Six Nations that includes six miles on each side of the Grand River. Our active work toward reconciliation takes place across our campuses through research, learning, teaching, and community building, and is co-ordinated within the Office of Indigenous Relations.
